name: us1-recognition-second-run
description: Reconcile a three-story specification twice against the mocked Jira double: the first run creates three tickets and stamps three markers; the second run recognises all three by their recorded key and creates nothing (the reported defect, now fixed). SPEC_KIT_JIRA_ID_SOURCE pins the three identifiers so the resulting spec.md is byte-identical across ports (research R4).
